description: A link destination holding a `${…}` is data-led: written through the §5.2 rule 3 runtime guard, so a `javascript:` value becomes `about:blank`; a literal prefix that proves a relative path keeps the value from choosing a scheme.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F2 "yes a." (same closed element/attribute set, same §5.2 URL guard)
rationale: §67.4: a destination holding an atom is data-led — written through §5.2 rule 3 at run time (an unadmitted scheme becomes `about:blank`), exactly as a non-literal `href=` is; when the literal text before the first atom proves a relative URL, the value cannot change the scheme.
